races.title: Jumps Look Better On Racing TV Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: THEY'RE CHANCERS has been an infrequent visitor to the track but has looked promising when we have seen him and his pedigree points to this longer trip being within range. Hexham scorer Finisk Pride may give him most to think about. THEY'RE CHANCERS (IRE) FINISK PRIDE (IRE) WHISKEY ON ICE (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Finisk Pride (11/10), Gentle Ocean (15/8), Whiskey On Ice (3/1), They're Chancers (7/2), Blazing Court (66/1)

races.title: Graeme Todd Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div 1)
races.verdict: Lots of these arrive with a question mark against them and it could pay to side with the lightly-raced KING HORSE taking a sizeable step forward now with Nicky Richards and capitalising on a lenient-looking mark. Tigress Lilly arrives in top form and rates a big danger though, while handicap debutant Old Comrades can also play a prominent role. KING HORSE (FR) TIGRESS LILLY OLD COMRADES (IRE)

races.title: Graeme Todd Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div 2)
races.verdict: Lots with chances but LESTER MAIL rates just the pick of the weights and is taken to build on a recent Hexham third after an absence and add to his bumper success here. Valtteri Its James heads the dangers, although a market move for Annual Invitation could prove significant. LESTER MAIL (FR) VALTTERI ITS JAMES (IRE) ANNUAL INVITATION (IRE)

races.title: luckytiger.co.uk Bet 20 Win 20 Wishing Well Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: None of the quartet can be ruled out but veteran KITTY'S LIGHT made a promising return from a long absence when an unlucky Fakenham fifth in May and gets the vote here off a handy-looking mark. Last year's victor Cadell could prove the chief danger ahead of Ki Woo . KITTY'S LIGHT CADELL (IRE) KI WOO (FR)
races.bettingForecast: Ned Tanner (2/1), Cadell (5/2), Ki Woo (11/4), Kitty's Light (10/3)

races.title: luckytiger.co.uk Best Odds Guaranteed The Night Before Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: HOURMAN looked an improved model when making an impressive winning reappearance at Hexham and with this return to a longer trip also a plus he gets a confident vote. Moon Over America returns from a year's absence but remains with potential and could emerge as the chief threat ahead of Pure Gold and last year's victor Heart Above . HOURMAN (FR) MOON OVER AMERICA (IRE) PURE GOLD
